name: bot-terbaru
description: WhatsApp bot (@vanzxy/baileys) dengan dashboard kontrol berbasis web

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,DASHBOARD -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix dashboard"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix server
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix dashboard
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm install --prefix dashboard --include=dev && npm run build --prefix dashboard
